{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''TT4449''''' was a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] employed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to extract [[Alliance Military/Legends|officers]] from the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Anvil (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Anvil'']] which had been severely [[Defense of the Anvil|damaged]] and needed to be abandoned. Three [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], one of which piloted by [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], provided support and cover for the convoy of ships to escape to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]].
